summary: Frontend-only test of Studio Gallery 'Servis Paketleri' tab. All acceptance criteria met: login with admin@fotuber.com.tr via /personel-girisi works; /studyo/galeri loads; sg-tab-packs is selectable; add form contains sg-pack-kind (select with 8 options: Baskı, Çerçeve, Ahşap Tablo, Cam Tablo, Albüm, Kanvas, Retouch, Diğer), sg-pack-name, sg-pack-price, sg-pack-limit and sg-create-pack. Created 'Cam Tablo / 30x40 Cam Tablo / 500 / limit 2' -> success toast 'Hizmet eklendi' shown, new row displays 'Cam Tablo' badge + name + '+500₺' + 'maks 2 adet'. Created second service with empty price and limit 0 -> row shows 'Ücretsiz' and '· sınırsız'. Deleted a service via trash button -> row disappeared (row count went from 7 to 6 including form testids). No console errors from the packs feature (only pre-existing unrelated 401 for public endpoints and SVG circle warnings from another page).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 gallery service packs during test (30x40 Cam Tablo, TEST_Ucretsiz); TEST_Ucretsiz was deleted at end; 30x40 Cam Tablo remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login route is /personel-girisi (not /login). Packs tab UI works fully with kind badge, price display, limit display, delete flow, and success toast.
